label: CDC SARS-CoV-2 Variant Proportions
notes: Socrata paginated CSV export; 89 page(s); page_size=50000. The raw file contains both USA-level and HHS-region records. Formal diagnostic-event construction selects USA-level smoothed biweekly rows only; no state-level mapping is used. No public issue-date history; variants are diagnostic-only and do not enter forecast covariates or posterior evidence.
